sourceFindings.reason: USDA record specifies whole cumin; cannot treat as ground cumin teaspoon.
USDA provides an edible onion portion; recipe does not define onion size, so 143 g is not yet appropriate for every instance.
Different USDA whole onion sizes highlight missing recipe definition.
The 44 g yield can support clearly specified full-juice use, but cannot be assumed for optional wedges, partial squeezes, or uncertain yields.

editorialRequirements: Specify onion size or raw edible weight per recipe.
For lime recipes, explicitly state how much juice is squeezed and separate optional wedges.
Locate a ground-cumin-specific teaspoon or mass source; do not use whole-seed density.
